P.name: Transcendent
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Syndra''' collects {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, {{tip|stack|stacking}} up to 120 times. She gains {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} from the following:
* Dealing two instances of {{tip|champion ability|ability}} damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants {{as|{{pp|1;2;3|1;11;18}} Splinters|buzzword}}. This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
* Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants {{as|5 Splinters|buzzword}}, up to {{as|85|buzzword}}.
* Killing a large minion grants {{as|1 Splinter|buzzword}}.
P.description2: Collecting a {{as|Splinter of Wrath|buzzword}} from an enemy restores {{sti|mana|{{as|{{pp|16+4*x for 6; then +6*x for 4; then +15*x for 5; then +20*x for 5|formula=15 + 4 per level until level 6, then + 6 per level until level 10, then + 15 per level until level 15, then + 20 per level.}} mana}}}}. {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} are brought to '''Syndra''' from enemies over {{fd|0.6}} seconds.
P.description3: At {{as|120 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}}, '''Syndra''' achieves ''Transcendence'', increasing her {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} by 15%.
P.description4: '''''Syndra''' can collect {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} from enemies even if she is at maximum stacks. These {{as|Splinters|buzzword}} do not grant any stacks, but will still restore {{as|mana}} for '''Syndra'''.''

Q.name: Dark Sphere
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' conjures a ''Dark Sphere'' at the target location that appears after a {{fd|0.6}}-second delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. The ''Dark Sphere'' then remains on the ground for 6 seconds.
Q.description2: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|40 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} causes '''Syndra''' to periodically [[stock]] a ''Dark Sphere'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Q.recharge: {{tt|7|Recharge timer for Dark Sphere with the Transcendent bonus}}
Q.static: {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Cooldown between casts for Dark Sphere with the Transcendent bonus}}

W.name: Force of Will
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' telekinetically grabs the nearest ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'', enemy {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}} within 500 units from the target location, and holds the target near her for 5 seconds. If a ''Dark Sphere'' is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in {{tip|stasis}}. She prioritizes grabbing the nearest unit, then ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}''.
W.description2: ''Force of Will'' can be recast while the target is being held.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Syndra''' throws the grabbed target towards the target location, granting {{tip|sight}} of their surroundings as they fall and dealing {{as|magic damage}} to them and nearby enemies once they land. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|60 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Force of Will'' to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|12%|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

If a ''Dark Sphere'' is grabbed, its duration is refreshed; if a minion or monster is grabbed, it is put in {{tip|stasis}}. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 25% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|60 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Force of Will'' to deal {{sti|true damage|{{as|12%|true damage}}}} {{as|(+ 2% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}.

E.name: Scatter the Weak
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} for 400 units and up to 800 units away from '''Syndra''' based on proximity, though not through terrain.
E.description2: ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' can be knocked back for 950 units and up to 1200 units away from '''Syndra''' based on proximity, {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} enemies they hit over 70 units, though not through terrain. Targets hit are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, during which they are also {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}, and dealt ''Scatter the Weak's'' damage if they were not damaged by the initial cast.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|80 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Scatter the Weak'' to have an increased scatter angle and {{tip|slow}} enemies hit by 70% for {{fd|1.25}} seconds starting after the {{tip|airborne|knock back}} ends or if the target was hit by a pushed ''Dark Sphere'', after the {{tip|stun}} has ended.

R.name: Unleashed Power
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} ''{{ais|Dark Sphere|Syndra}}'' cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}}.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Syndra''' conjures 3 ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected ''Dark Spheres'', each dealing {{as|magic damage}} upon hit.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage per Sphere|{{ap|80 to 160}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|80*3 to 160*3}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*3}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|80*7 to 160*7}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*7}}% AP)}}}}
R.description3: The ''{{ai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Dark Spheres}}'' will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.
R.description4: {{sbc|{{ai|Transcendent|Syndra}} Bonus:}} Collecting {{as|100 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} enhances ''Unleashed Power'' to {{tip|execute}} the target if it would damage them to below {{sti|{{as|15% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}.
